note: The metadata cache image message length is decoded from the input file's superblock extension into mesg->size.
The decoded metadata cache image size is passed to the metadata cache image loader setup.
The input-controlled image length is accepted as cache_ptr->image_len without requiring it to be at least the four-byte cache image signature length.
Only image_len plus one bytes are allocated for the cache image buffer, so the corrupted length 2 creates a three-byte heap allocation.
The undersized heap buffer is passed to cache image reconstruction for header decoding.
The decoder compares four signature bytes from p even though the heap buffer derived from image_len may contain fewer than four accessible bytes.
